newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates MedPartners Inc BBB corporate credit.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates MedPartners Inc BBB corporate credit.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned its BBB corporate credit rating to MedPartners Inc.
The outlook was stable, S&P said in a statment.
"MedPartners has acquired Caremark International Inc and has assumed its $100 million 6.875 percent senior notes due 2003," S&P said.

S&P said it had raised its rating on this issue to BBB from BBB minus as a result of the acquisition, better-than-anticipated prospects for the combined entity, and MedPartners' commitment to a conservative financial policy.

"MedPartners' investment-grade rating reflects the company's important positions in diverse businesses and conservative financial policies, offset by a short record of success and aggressive growth strategies," S&P said.

"The merger with Caremark International Inc significantly increases the company's presence in physician practice management, and diversifies the company's operations into the pharmaceutical benefit management and disease management businesses," the rating agency said.
"The merger further bolsters the company's position and negotiating leverage in its important Southern California market, while removing a strong competitor," siad S&P.
"Given the wide variation of physician practice patterns across the country, significant opportunity exists for MedPartners if it can implement best practice methodologies successfully."
S&P said the challenges of controlling and increasing the growth of a $4 billion company that was founded only four years ago were formidable.
"Additionally, the company is susceptible to reimbursement changes, with several physician practice management markets experiencing actual declines in reimbursement," said S&P.
"Moreover, competition is increasing, as the highly fragmented physician marketplace is rapidly consolidating."
S&P said it expected MedPartners to maintain its financial conservatism, while integrating and further expanding operations in a challenging and dynamic business environment.
